items.title: Nvidia tightens tracking of AI GPUs in Southeast Asia as Chinese chip smuggling draws scrutiny, report claims
items.summary: Nvidia is requiring Southeast Asian cloud providers seeking Nvidia Cloud Partner status to enroll in its Fleet Intelligence tracking program, giving the chipmaker greater visibility into where its AI GPUs are deployed. The move comes as Washington increases pressure over suspected chip smuggling into China, with investigations involving Megaspeed International and Super Micro highlighting the challenges of enforcing U.S. export restrictions
items.title_original: Nvidia tightens tracking of AI GPUs in Southeast Asia as Chinese chip smuggling draws scrutiny, report claims
items.title_en: Nvidia tightens tracking of AI GPUs in Southeast Asia as Chinese chip smuggling draws scrutiny, report claims

items.summary_zh: Nvidia 要求寻求 Nvidia 云合作伙伴身份的东南亚云提供商加入其 Fleet Intelligence 跟踪计划，从而使该芯片制造商能够更好地了解其 AI GPU 的部署位置。此举出台之际，华盛顿加大了对涉嫌走私芯片进入中国的压力，涉及Megaspeed International和Super Micro的调查凸显了执行美国出口限制的挑战
